Kapsam: s-social/Social Stack için yalnız app assembly, installation/configuration lifecycle, entitlement wiring ve public SDK port sınırını üret.
Güvenlik sınırı: Domain verisini veya business lifecycle'ı app-core'a kopyalama; direct app/module import, kernel internals ve cross-context write kullanma.
Çıktı: Test-first acceptance, compatibility/negative test, evidence criterion ve rollback sözleşmesine bağlanan Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik kararı.

nfrBudgets.latency: Draft real-time baseline: interactive/event p95 <= 250 ms and p99 <= 750 ms at approved load
nfrBudgets.throughput: Draft baseline: sustain approved peak x2 without breaching latency or error budgets
nfrBudgets.scalability: Draft baseline: horizontal scale verification at approved peak x2
nfrBudgets.retention: workforce-and-candidate-data, communications-and-content-data, tenant-business-data, audit-metadata, configuration-data sınıfları için jurisdiction policy, legal hold, deletion ve restore kanıtı zorunludur
nfrBudgets.cost: FinOps budget and per-tenant cost guardrail must be approved before development

module data ownership and reversible schema contract owner
module SDK-generated implementation and compatibility checks owner
module functional, security, accessibility and performance QA owner
